title: AI Network Assistant
description: Describe a network issue. The assistant can execute terminal commands to investigate or fix it and show their results. Conversations and drafts are saved locally; tasks continue when you navigate away.
welcome: Check your network with the assistant
storageError: The conversation could not be saved locally. Check the application's storage space.
inputHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
diagnosisPrompt: Diagnose my network. Compare direct and proxy connectivity to www.google.com and www.bing.com, inspect proxy, DNS and routes, and explain the evidence. Do not propose changes yet.
configurationPrompt: Inspect my current network and suggest minimal useful configuration changes with previews. Explain the purpose and effect of each change; do not propose enabling TUN without evidence that it is needed.
placeholder: For example: Google fails in Chrome while terminal requests work. Check the likely cause.
applied: Setting applied. Run another diagnosis to check the result.
otherConversationRunning: Another conversation is running. You can edit your draft and send it when the task finishes.
chainPrompt: Read my current profile nodes and groups and create a proxy-chain preview. Confirm the transit selector, exit node and traffic group. Ask me to choose if multiple exits are plausible. Prefer a /204 probe on the exit server. Use the proxy-chain preview tool instead of editing subscription files with terminal commands.
chainPersistence: Saved as an override for this profile; survives restarts and subscription updates and can be undone.
composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

transit.missing_url: Transit group “{{group}}” needs a /204 URL. Configure it in the AI Network Assistant.
transit.no_chain: No measurable chain in this profile. Configure transit and exit in the AI Network Assistant.
transit.unreachable: No transit node reached the probe URL. Check the /204 service and connectivity.
transit.changed: The chain changed during measurement; no selection updated.
transit.failed: Transit measurement failed. Inspect the AI Network Assistant diagnostics.
